Longitudinal Clinical Trajectory Plot Type

Source: R/type_trajectory.R
type_trajectory.Rd

Creates publication-ready longitudinal clinical trajectories (Clinical Archetype 4). Overlays semi-transparent individual patient spaghetti trajectories onto shaded background clinical severity bands (e.g., Mild, Moderate, Severe) or clean clinical frames, anchored by bold group mean trajectories with standard error bars (or 95% CI ribbons), distinct markers across recovery time points, and sample-size annotations.

Usage

type_trajectory(
  patient_id = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  score = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  severity_bands = list(Mild = c(0, 25), Moderate = c(25, 50), Severe = c(50, 100)),
  severity_colors = c(Mild = "#D9EEF7", Moderate = "#FDE8D7", Severe = "#FADBD8"),
  spaghetti_alpha = 0.18,
  spaghetti_width = 0.35,
  spaghetti_color = "grey45",
  show_mean = TRUE,
  mean_color = "#005EB8",
  mean_width = 1.2,
  show_ci = FALSE,
  show_errorbar = TRUE,
  errorbar = c("se", "ci", "sd", "none"),
  errorbar_width = 0.14,
  errorbar_lwd = 0.85,
  point_shape = 21,
  point_size = 3.2,
  point_stroke = 1.1,
  point_fill = "white",
  dodge = 0.15,
  show_n = TRUE,
  xlab = "Study Visit / Time",
  ylab = "Clinical Severity Score"
)

Arguments

patient_id

Column name for individual patient/participant IDs.

time

Column name for longitudinal visit/time values.

score

Column name for clinical score/measurement.

group

Optional column name for treatment arm or cohort stratification.

severity_bands

Named list defining intervals for background severity shading (default list(Mild = c(0, 25), Moderate = c(25, 50), Severe = c(50, 100))). Set to NULL for clean background without bands.

severity_colors

Named vector of fill colors for severity bands (default c(Mild = "#D9EEF7", Moderate = "#FDE8D7", Severe = "#FADBD8")).

spaghetti_alpha

Opacity of individual patient trajectories (default 0.18).

spaghetti_width

Line width of individual trajectories (default 0.35).

spaghetti_color

Color of individual trajectories (default "grey45").

show_mean

Overlay bold group mean trajectory (default TRUE).

mean_color

Color of group summary line when unstratified (default "#005EB8").

mean_width

Line width of group summary line (default 1.2).

show_ci

Add standard error or 95% CI ribbon around mean (default FALSE when errorbar is shown).

show_errorbar

Display vertical error bars with crossbar caps (default TRUE).

errorbar

Type of error bar to compute: "se" (standard error of the mean), "ci" (Student's t / 95% CI), "sd" (standard deviation), or "none".

errorbar_width

Width of the horizontal error bar cap (default 0.14).

errorbar_lwd

Line width of the error bar stroke (default 0.85).

point_shape

Shape of the mean glyph (default 21, filled circle with colored border).

point_size

Size of the mean glyph (default 3.2).

point_stroke

Stroke width of the mean glyph border (default 1.1).

point_fill

Interior fill of the mean glyph ("white" for crisp journal look, or "color").

dodge

Horizontal dodging distance for stratified comparison arms (default 0.15).

show_n

Display visit sample sizes ($n = ...$) above plot (default TRUE).

xlab

Axis label for time/visit (default "Study Visit / Time").

ylab

Axis label for clinical score (default "Clinical Severity Score").

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
set.seed(42)
n_pts = 30
visits = c("BL", "M3", "M6", "M12")
traj_df = expand.grid(Patient = paste0("Pt_", 1:n_pts), Visit = visits)
traj_df$Score = pmax(0, pmin(80, rnorm(nrow(traj_df), mean = 40, sd = 15)))

cliplot(Score ~ Visit | Patient, data = traj_df, type = "trajectory")
} # }
